framework: TorchNeuron (torch-neuronx) native PyTorch backend + TRL GRPO
compute: AWS EC2 trn2.48xlarge spot, ap-south-2b (single NeuronCore, NEURON_RT_VISIBLE_CORES=0)
scope: RL / GRPO stage only. SFT stays on Tinker; this loads the merged cholec-sft-qwen3.5-4b checkpoint.

experiments.name: cholect50_grpo_smoke
experiments.sft_checkpoint: Tinker output, LoRA merged (same checkpoint as verl, Miles, SkyRL)
experiments.note: Go/no-go smoke only. Platform works; no learning (flat reward). See final_results.json and TRAINIUM_ISSUES_LOG.md.

findings: TorchNeuron runs the Qwen3.5-4B VLM (8 full-attention + 24 Gated DeltaNet layers) on the neuron device in eager mode. A full GRPO training step and eval both complete.

The Qwen3.5 vision tower uses torch.repeat_interleave with a dynamic repeats tensor. The AMI-bundled torch-neuronx 2.14.3.0.1 crashes the StableHLO lowering; 2.14.3.0.282 compiles it under torch.compile but crashes neuronx-cc. Fix = monkeypatch the vision interpolation precompute onto CPU (scripts/grpo_train.py:_patch_vision_interp).

transformers Trainer forces torch.compile whenever torch_compile_backend is non-None (accelerate >= 1.2.0), even with torch_compile=False. Fix = pass the neuron backend only when compilation is wanted.

Single NeuronCore HBM = 25.8 GB. GRPO with beta!=0 loads a second full model copy (~10 GB) as the reference model, and full fine-tune AdamW keeps ~41 GB of fp32 states. Neither fits one core. verl fits by FSDP(size 4) + param_offload + optimizer_offload, which TRL-on-Neuron has no equivalent for.

TRL 1.16 passes conversational completions to the reward as message lists ([{"role":"assistant","content":...}]), not strings, and passes the label through the 'label' column. scripts/reward_tr.py unwraps both.
The Gated DeltaNet / linear-attention layers fall back to reference PyTorch because causal_conv1d and flash-linear-attention are not on the Neuron AMI. Correct but much slower.
torch_neuronx empty_cache() is required between training and eval, or the eval's fused-LM-head logits (~288 MB) fail to allocate because the training-time buffers stay cached in the Neuron allocator.
